summary.content:
Today's selection covers 101 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 67 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Nvidia is buying Hugging Face for almost $13 billion
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: US charges Russian for infecting 80,000 freelancers with malware
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 58 articles published in the last 24 hours
